cohort: The study included 72 pregnancies in female liver transplant recipients who delivered between 2001 and 2022 at a single tertiary referral center.
finding: Pre-pregnancy overweight and obesity were not significantly associated with adverse obstetric or neonatal outcomes in liver transplant recipients, although observed trends suggested a potential predisposition to hypertensive disorders.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was more prevalent among overweight/obese individuals, though this difference did not reach statistical significance.
